title: User Registration and Login Flow
registration_flow: START: User submits registration form (username, mobile, email, address, pincode, password, confirmPassword)
[NO] → set status = 'Password not matching!' → forward to register.jsp?message=status → END
[YES] → create UserBean(userName, mobileNo, emailId, address, pinCode, password)
UserServiceImpl.isRegistered(emailId): SELECT * FROM user WHERE email=?
[YES] → return 'Email Id Already Registered!' → forward to register.jsp?message=status → END
INSERT INTO user VALUES(email, name, mobile, address, pincode, password)
login_flow: START: User submits login form (username, password, usertype)
logout_flow: forward to login.jsp?message=Successfully Logged Out! → END
key_relationships: UserServiceImpl calls DBUtil.provideConnection() for DB access
UserServiceImpl calls MailMessage.registrationSuccess() on successful registration
All servlets: doPost() delegates to doGet()
views_navigated: login.jsp (login form / error with message param)
important_notes: No email confirmation step in actual code — MailMessage.registrationSuccess sends a notification but there is no email-verification gate before account activation. Admin login uses hardcoded credentials (admin@gmail.com / admin). Customer credentials validated via DB query. Session stores username, password, usertype, and full UserBean (userdata) for customers. LogoutSrv nullifies all session attributes rather than invalidating the session.
